## What's new in 1.1

- **1,500 words in three tiers:** Beginner, Expert and Master, ordered from most to least common.
- **Sets of ten in a suggested order.** You can open any set. Learn all ten words for a set bonus, then remember them over the following days for a gold star.
- **Placement quiz** to find your starting point.
- **Hover definitions:** point at any synonym or antonym to see what it means.
- **Players:** up to eight people can share one computer, each with their own progress.
- **Review screen** for words that are due.

**Updating from 1.0:** run the new installer. It installs over the old version, and your progress carries over. A backup of your old save is kept as `progress.json.v1-backup` in `%APPDATA%\Vocab Quest`.

## Download

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| **VocabQuest-Setup-x.y.z.exe** | Installer. Adds Vocab Quest to the Start menu and desktop. No admin rights needed. **Recommended.** |
| **VocabQuest-Portable-x.y.z.exe** | Runs without installing, for example from a USB stick. |
| SHA256SUMS.txt | Checksums so you can verify the download. |

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit). Free and open source under the MIT License.

### First launch

The app isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"**. Click **More info → Run anyway**. Vocab Quest works fully offline, never connects to the internet, and stores your progress only on your computer.

### Pronunciation

Words are spoken with the voices built into Windows. To add or change voices: **Settings → Time & language → Speech → Add voices**.
